question: On the shipped 0.15.0 build, with six fresh worlds, does a transition budget of 40 recover the measured rank-21-40 band without a false-admission rate more than 10 percentage points above the cap-40 baseline, and at which lower rung does recovery begin?

program.relationship: BAND-5 established the endpoints on fresh worlds: 0 of 89 measured rank-21-40 edges entered service at cap 40 and 89 of 89 did at cap 112. This block is the dose-response between those endpoints. It does not reuse BAND-5 cells, band identities or verdicts.

reconciliation.endpoints_known: BAND-5 measured 0/89 band service at cap 40 and 89/89 at cap 112 on seeds 20612601-20612606. Those endpoints are prior evidence, not cells of this block.
reconciliation.gap: Caps 56 and 80 are the untested rungs. Cap 80 is the smallest rung whose nominal 40-transition floor reaches rank 40; cap 56 reaches only rank 28.
reconciliation.allocation: The shipped split gives half the cap to entropy-ranked transitions and half to count-ranked cooccurrences. The engine may backfill unused cooccurrence seats with further transitions, so actual transition counts are recorded per window rather than assumed.
reconciliation.false_admission: A higher cap can recover the band by serving more rows. The block therefore charges every served row that is not a present world edge, not only rows outside the named band.

design.cells_arithmetic: 4 caps x 6 seeds = 24 cells; one fresh-process determinism rerun at cap 80
design.world: the PHASE_ACQUISITION compositional world at 120 cycles
design.pairing: each seed's world and stimulus are identical at all four caps
design.freshness: Six fresh seeds; seed_collisions is empty at freeze time.
design.reuse: No prior block's cells, named band or verdict is reused; BAND-5 is cited only as prior evidence.

band.definition: For each seed, every present transition at minimum cap-112 block rank 21-40; measured from the 112 universe and not filtered by service at any lower cap.
band.identity: Each band edge is named by source>target and carries its minimum cap-112 rank; a missing rank is a ledger failure, not a zero.
band.expected_size: Measured per seed; BAND-5 observed 11-19 edges per seed, and no fixed band size is assumed.
band.zero_band: A zero band is a zero denominator and makes the block VOID.

false_admission.definition: A served row whose source>target edge is not in the seed's present world transitions, where present = world edges intersected with the temporal rows retained at the end of the cell.
false_admission.numerator: served rows that are not present world transitions, summed over all cycles and windows
false_admission.denominator: all served rows, summed over all cycles and windows
false_admission.unit: computed per seed and pooled by summing rows, never by averaging per-cycle ratios
false_admission.comparison: Paired cap-80 minus cap-40 false-admission rate for each seed; the upper bound of a 10,000-resample seed-cluster bootstrap must be at or below +0.10.
false_admission.why_10pp: The margin is pre-set, not fitted. The earlier cap-40 ladder recorded a world-row share of 0.239-0.278, so the non-world baseline is roughly 0.72-0.76; +10 pp bounds the worsening to about one-eighth of that baseline rather than permitting a free precision collapse.
false_admission.not_the_same_as: A served world edge outside rank 21-40 is collateral service, not a false admission; it is reported separately.

gates.L1_build: one shipped 0.15.0 build across all cells; only MAX_PREDICTIONS differs
gates.L2_world: each seed has the same world digest and present fingerprint at all four caps
gates.L3_band_identity: each band edge is a present transition at rank 21-40 with a recorded rank and source>target identity
gates.L4_control_40: cap 40 serves no band edge and its full 40-row windows satisfy the 20-transition floor and the 20-cooccurrence cap
gates.L5_allocation_law: every full window has transitions + cooccurrences = cap, transitions >= cap//2, cooccurrences <= cap//2, with actual counts and relations recorded
gates.L6_denominator: every seed has a non-empty band, at least one served row, and every band edge reaches the ledger
gates.L7_determinism: a fresh-process rerun of seed 20614101 at cap 80 reproduces its windows and ledger
gates.L8_seed_axis: at least three distinct served-band sets across the six seeds
gates.L9_false_ledger: every served row is classified present or not-present, and no served row is unparsed or missing a rank where a transition rank is required

primary_band_recovery.metric: measured band edges served at least once / measured band edges
primary_band_recovery.pooled: pooled numerator and denominator across the six seeds
primary_band_recovery.prediction: 0.85-1.00, with schema cycles the likely shortfall

co_primary_false_admission.metric: paired cap-80 minus cap-40 false-admission rate

ceiling.metric: measured band edges served at least once / measured band edges
ceiling.role: ceiling control, not the primary rung

false_admission.metric: paired cap-112 minus cap-40 false-admission rate

secondary: cap-80 and cap-112 actual transition and cooccurrence counts
served world edges outside the band (collateral service)
monotonicity of band recovery across the four caps

predictions.prediction: 0.00 band recovery; the cap-40 control serves no rank-21-40 edge.
0.30-0.60 band recovery, because only ranks 21-28 are nominally reached.
0.85-1.00 band recovery; schema rows can push a few rank-40 edges past the 40-transition floor.
0.95-1.00 band recovery; BAND-5 observed 89/89 at this cap.
false-admission rate rises weakly with cap; the cap-80 paired upper bound stays at or below +0.10.
band recovery is nondecreasing across 40, 56, 80 and 112.

analysis.primary: Pooled and per-seed band recovery at cap 80; exact McNemar on the paired band-edge service indicator against cap 40, where the cap-40 control should leave every band edge unserved.
analysis.false_admission: Per-seed false-admission rates with numerators and denominators; paired cap-80 minus cap-40 difference, plus the cap-112 minus cap-40 difference used by the ceiling branch; 10,000-resample seed-cluster bootstrap for each upper 95% bound. The seed is the resampling unit.
analysis.dose: Report cap 56 and cap 112 recovery and the four-rung sequence. A monotonicity failure is reported as a failure, not smoothed.
analysis.multiplicity: The cap-80 band and false-admission endpoints are co-primary; all other rungs and outcomes are secondary and labelled so.
analysis.missing_data: No seed, cap or cycle is dropped; a missing cell makes the block VOID.
analysis.no_fitting: The band definition, primary rung, margin and bars are frozen before any cell.

decision_table.condition: L1-L4, L6 or L9 fails; a band is empty; or a required ledger row is missing
decision_table.reading: the block did not produce a readable band, a valid control or a complete false-admission ledger
decision_table.decision: record VOID; fix the failed gate and register a new block; read no recovery

decision_table.reading: the allocation, determinism or seed-axis gate did not hold
decision_table.decision: record VOID; do not interpret a band rate from an unreadable ladder

decision_table.condition: gates pass and cap-112 band recovery is below 0.50
decision_table.reading: even the ceiling control does not recover the band on these worlds
decision_table.decision: the cap or transition budget is not the gate; next test candidate formation or the rank itself

decision_table.condition: gates pass and cap-112 band recovery is 0.50-0.90
decision_table.reading: the budget helps but does not recover the measured band uniformly
decision_table.decision: report the per-edge misses; do not adopt a cap; next test the residual rank or allocation rule

decision_table.condition: gates pass; cap-80 recovery is below 0.90; cap-112 recovery is at least 0.90 and its false-admission upper bound is at most +0.10
decision_table.reading: 80 is insufficient, while the shipped 112 budget recovers the band at acceptable false-admission cost
decision_table.decision: record the threshold; the owner may consider 112 as the operating rung, with the measured cost

decision_table.condition: gates pass; cap-80 recovery is at least 0.90; false-admission upper bound is above +0.10
decision_table.reading: the band returns at 80, but the window pays more than the pre-set false-admission margin
decision_table.decision: do not adopt 80 on band recovery alone; report the trade-off and test a precision-preserving admission rule

decision_table.condition: gates pass; cap-80 recovery is at least 0.90; false-admission upper bound is at most +0.10; cap-112 recovery is at least 0.95
decision_table.reading: the 80 rung recovers the measured 21-40 band without excessive false admissions, and 112 remains the ceiling control
decision_table.decision: record the confirmation; the owner decides any engine or operating change; no capability claim

authorisation.note: No grant is recorded and no authorisation request is made by this record. The runner and every cell refuse while granted is false.

runner.why: The cell runner is built behind the grant check. It opens no database and runs no cell while granted is false.

cost.runtime: not claimed; no cell has run

not_evidence: A preregistration, not a result. It measures band service and false admissions on one synthetic world family. It does not establish capability, retention, transfer, or a general operating cap.
